name: Four of the 'factories' (trading bases) at Canton (Guangzhou)
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A detailed drawing of four of the 'factories' (or 'hongs') in the central section of the site allotted to the Western trading nations - known in the 1830s as (l. to r.) the American, Paoushun, Imperial and Swedish 'factories'.
